An early spring view of Chequamegon Bay of Lake Superior in Wisconsin
#Scapes

It's beginning to look a lot like winter in the Chequamegon Bay area of Lake Superior. Photo taken off the coal dock in Washburn, Wisconsin today.
#scape #LakeSuperior #weather
I've been watching this ice around the Apostle Islands in Lake Superior, and this is the best yet. Sentinel 2, March 1, 2025.
One more ice image: Ice in bays on the south shore of Lake Superior yesterday. Cornucopia, Wisconsin, is on the second bay from the right.
Ice on Lake Superior in Chequamegon Bay, also Jan 27. Ashland, Wisconsin in the lower left, mouth of Bad River and Odanah to the east, Washburn, Bayfield, and Madeline Island to the north

Inside a Lake Superior ice cave, with a little light filtering in from outside. This was taken in 2014, one of the last times the ice on the lake was thick enough to hike across. It was -13 degrees that day. #IceCave #LakeSuperior #SandIsland #Wisconsin #Ice #IceCrystal #Light #Nature #Photography

Winter Landsat 9 visible bands image of ice on Chequamegon Bay on Lake Superior, northern Wisconsin (Left), and surface temperature from thermal IR (ST band) of the same image (Right), color scale adjusted to bring out (relatively) warm open water, cooler ice-covered areas, and cold land surface.

Chequamegon Bay, Lake Superior, 12-12-2024. Landsat 8. Left: Visible bands (4,3,2) showing partial ice cover on the bay. Right: Surface temperature from thermal IR (band 10). Marker at city of Ashland. Lake Superior water is cold, but much warmer than the land or ice surfaces

I’m from Ashland, WI and you should come when the ice road is frozen and drive to Madeline Island across Lake Superior. Stop in the middle, pull over, take pictures, listen to the ice crack and boom under your feet.

Book Across the Bay - a ski/snowshoe event across Chequamagon Bay in Ashland, WI - has been cancelled due to… ongoing snowfall and strong winds. Sad to see given the amount of prep that goes into this unique winter event on the frozen bay of Lake Superior!
The icy frozen Chequamegon Bay on Lake Superior
Wolf moon 2025. Chequamegon Bay, Lake Superior. -1°F

Same situation on the south shore of Lake Superior. Some sparse snow events over the last few weeks, but nothing sticks. Lots of cloud cover, the daytime temps hover near freezing, w/high humidity. The ice on Chequamegon Bay is being reported in "tenths" of inches. Snow amounts usually btwn 9-14 ft.
More ice starting to form unique seasonal cliffs and arches along the edge of Lake Superior (I’m actually standing near what I think is the shore… the rest is ice!)
Ice formations along the frozen cliffs of Lake Superior - Red Cliff, Wisconsin
Image of Chequamegon Bay - Lake Superior, south shore, Wisco.
